name: Old City of Sana'a
description: Sana'a's old city sits in a mountain valley in Yemen, 2,200 metres above sea level, and has been lived in for over 2,500 years. Its narrow lanes wind between tall tower-houses of rammed earth, decorated with white friezes and stained-glass windows. Within the old walls are over 100 mosques, including one of the world's oldest, and the Salt Market. The site is now listed as in danger.
